Printing Challenges for Canva AI

Canva Magic Media generates quick concepts, but Canva's default print PDF export often compresses images to low DPI. We recreate Canva AI assets into high-resolution, press-ready master files.

📌 Summary & Print Targets

  • ✓ Native resolution (Standard Screen Resolutions at 72–150 DPI) must be converted to 300 DPI Press Standard.
  • ✓ Screen sRGB colors must be mapped to physical CMYK press profiles.
  • ✓ 0.125” safety bleeds and vector cut paths must be established.

Common Print Issues with Raw Canva AI Files

✕ Common Issue

Canva exports often downsample images or use sRGB color profiles.

✕ Common Issue

Lack of vector cut lines for stickers and packaging dielines.

✕ Common Issue

Text and background elements flattened into a single uneditable layer.

Our Professional Reproduction Workflow

✓ Standard Step

Separation of graphics, background, and typography into layered vectors.

✓ Standard Step

Conversion to commercial PDF/X-1a with calibrated CMYK profiles.

✓ Standard Step

Addition of precise 0.125" bleeds and crop marks.
